{"behavior":"answer","answer":"If you forgot your passcode, go to the sign‑in screen and tap **Forgot passcode**. Confirm the phone number on your account, enter the one‑time code we send, record a short selfie video, and then set a new passcode. If you’re worried about unauthorized access, you can also freeze your card and change your passcode as a precaution.","cited_article_ids":["passcode-reset"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"You can’t change your PIN at an ATM. To change it, open the NovaPay app, go to **Cards**, select your card, tap **PIN** and then **Change PIN**.","cited_article_ids":["card-pin"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"If you see a duplicate charge, first check with the merchant to confirm it wasn’t a separate purchase. If the merchant can’t help, open a dispute for the extra payment. Choose “Report a problem” in the app and include any receipt. This will start the dispute process for a payment you didn’t authorize or was charged twice.","cited_article_ids":["charged-twice","disputes-chargebacks"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"You can transfer money from an outside bank by topping up via bank transfer. Open **Add money** in the app, choose **Bank transfer**, copy the account details shown for the currency you want to send, and then send the money from your other bank using any reference shown in the app.","cited_article_ids":["topup-by-bank-transfer"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"That 4‑digit number is the verification code from a temporary charge we place when you add a new card. Look for the same code on the statement of the card you used to add money, then enter it in the app under Add money → Verify card. The charge will be refunded shortly.","cited_article_ids":["topup-verification"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"The rate you saw may have come from the merchant or ATM using their own conversion rate, which is often worse. If the rate shown doesn’t match NovaPay’s rules, you can contact support with the receipt. Check the transaction details in the app to see the currency, rate and any fees, and compare it to the NovaPay rate at the time of the withdrawal. If it still looks incorrect, let support know.","cited_article_ids":["foreign-payment-wrong-rate"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"When you withdraw cash, the ATM may add its own fee. The machine should display any charge before you confirm the transaction. If you think it’s a mistake, you can check the ATM’s displayed fee and compare it to what’s on your statement.","cited_article_ids":["cash-withdrawals","extra-statement-charge"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"If your identity verification is failing or stuck, try again with good lighting, a flat document showing all four corners, and no hats or sunglasses in the selfie video.
